summary.text: Caryn Ann Harlos is the Libertarian candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 45 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Max Brooks and Democrat Michael Clarkson.
She was also the Libertarian candidate for the same seat in 2020 and for Colorado State Senate District 2 in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Caryn Ann Harlos advanced from the Libertarian convention for Colorado House of Representatives District 45 on April 13, 2020, and lost the general election that year to incumbent Patrick Neville.
In 2024 she ran in the general election for Colorado State Senate District 2, which Lisa Frizell won.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Harlos said her campaign's key messages are that Colorado is unaffordable, that government is too big, and that small businesses need support.
